facts.value: About € 300/month for student housing in a shared apartment (Aalto 2026 brochure); HOAS shared rooms € 250-519/month
facts.notes: Main providers near Otaniemi are AYY and HOAS (HOAS covers Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa, Kauniainen). Aalto gives student-housing rents of roughly € 300-600/month.

facts.value: € 500-747/month for a HOAS student studio; private-market rent from about € 600/month upwards (Aalto)
facts.notes: HOAS range covers its whole Helsinki-region stock, not Espoo alone. Aalto's 'from € 600' refers to private-market accommodation in general, not specifically studios.
Brochure breakdown: student housing € 250-500, transport € 0-70, food € 250-350, other € 300-380.

facts.value: About € 50-70/month for a 30-day HSL student season ticket in the central Espoo/Helsinki zones (Aalto estimate)
facts.notes: hsl.fi returned HTTP 403 to automated fetches; operator price not confirmed. More zones cost more.

facts.value: Cold winters (daily means below 0 °C, about 100 days in SW Finland); shortest day about 6 h, longest nearly 19 h; summer daily means above 10 °C late May-mid Sept
facts.notes: FMI describes southern/south-western Finland; no Espoo-specific figures.

facts.value: Campus-centred student culture at Otaniemi (long traditions, overalls, events) and a large startup community (Aaltoes); Helsinki is next door
English enough for English-taught degrees and many daily situations; most employers require Finnish or Swedish
English often enough in IT, industry and international companies; many other jobs need Finnish/Swedish. Aalto runs career support and a Summer Job Day
